ReportType.description: Government Relations interactions logged via the Log Interaction flow. Used to count outreach emails sent (Interaction Type = Email) and meetings completed (Interaction Type = In Person) and to trend meetings over time. Interaction is a standard object that does not expose its parent Account's custom fields to custom report types, so government-level/district filtering is provided by the Account- and Activity-based reports instead.
ReportType.label: GR Interactions
